source.rule: a province is the same on both maps when its centroid moved at most 8 px, otherwise it is the nearest land centroid on the other map; the targets are the map states with at least half of their provinces from the vanilla state, and each map state that no vanilla state holds half of goes to the vanilla state with the largest part of it (on a tie, the one whose largest victory point lies there); the one holding its largest victory point comes first; when there is none, the map state holding that victory point; capital is the map state holding that victory point for single-valued references (capital, set_capital) when no other vanilla state holds half of it; overrides come from RkPlusRt56StateMapOverrides.json

states.name: Baghdad
states.reason: Road to 56's Dulaim (1047) is 2 provinces of Baghdad, 2 of Al Anbar and 1 of Mosul and goes to Al Anbar, which holds Ramadi; Baghdad takes it too, so RK+ lists of Baghdad and Mosul without Al Anbar (the Shocker world focus) still reach it

states.name: Easter Island
states.reason: Road to 56 draws Easter Island about 300 px from the game's island (province 13418 at 1113,1822 against 13294 at 1392,1702), so no province lines up; its state 1074 Easter Island is the same island
